declaration.purpose: Generate the D3 and D4 records D6 reads, in production, from code-owned evidence only. Every rule below is a direct reading of a frozen H-V2 contract line (cited) or a statutory fact; a field the frozen contracts leave to AI judgement with no code-decidable reading is not produced (abstention), and is listed with its effect on D6.
authority_order: historical model output (never an answer key)
declaration.revision_rule: a rule change after the replay is a new contract version (V2), never an edit of V1

d3_binding.business_model.revenue_drivers non-empty: APPROVE business_understood; REJECT thesis_unsupported_by_the_evidence_bundle when empty
d3_binding.fundamental_change count and source_id: APPROVE fundamental_change_anchored; REJECT thesis_unsupported when count 0
d3_binding.future_business stages and the five flag: APPROVE future_business_or_catalyst_meaningful; REJECT story_only (only when the list is non-empty)
d3_binding.catalyst_candidates count, materiality_c: APPROVE (material AND timed); REJECT no_catalyst_identifiable_in_the_thesis_horizon when count 0

d3_not_binding: growth_durability.state (basis text only; the deterioration trigger is NOT_EVALUATED in D6)

d4_binding.anything else (NEUTRAL, UNKNOWN, positiv: neither: WATCH unless another clause decides

d6_binding_projection.consequence: NEUTRAL versus UNKNOWN never changes a D6 decision; only the positive-at-MEDIUM path and the negative path do

d3.output_schema: h_research_interpretation_v2, validated with the package's own valid_source_ids / valid_evidence_ids and cross_check_fundamental_change_states; a record that fails validation has no final_output (D3_REFUSED_NO_FINAL_OUTPUT)

R3.1_business_model.rule: revenue_drivers = one FACT claim citing the first chunk with section BUSINESS of the package's LATEST_10K source; empty when the package has no such chunk
R3.1_business_model.basis: D0 §N3 'thesis unsupported by the evidence bundle': the deterministic thesis is the set of code-owned states, and the bundle supports it when the issuer's own business disclosure is in it. D0 §V keeps the interpretation of that text with AI, so code cites, never reads.
R3.1_business_model.claim_text: Issuer business description disclosed in the latest 10-K (section BUSINESS).
R3.1_business_model.claim_confidence: HIGH (a disclosure is present or it is not)

R3.2_fundamental_change.rule: one entry per bundle.fundamental_changes metric whose code-owned state is not UNKNOWN and whose latest point's accession is a package source with at least one chunk; code_owned_state = that state; explanation = one FACT claim stating the metric and state, citing that source's first chunk in RESULTS_OF_OPERATIONS, else MD_AND_A, else its first chunk; durability_relevant = false (schema-required, unread by D6)
R3.2_fundamental_change.basis: D0 §V 'fundamental-change detection (trend/acceleration flags) = code'; D1/E2 change_detection is the frozen detector; D3 §I 'why it changed' stays AI-owned and is not produced

R3.3_growth_durability.rule: state UNKNOWN, checklist all null, rationale empty
R3.3_growth_durability.basis: no frozen rule or validator maps evidence to a durability state (audit 2026-10-14)

R3.4_future_business.basis: D0 §J needs a named future-business line; no code-owned evidence identifies one, and the floor table maps stage to a minimum count of model-written flags, not evidence to stage

R3.5_catalyst.rule: one catalyst of type 'earnings' = the issuer's next periodic report, included when its statutory filing deadline is on or before the decision session + 3 calendar months
R3.5_catalyst.next_report: periodic reports = 10-K and 10-Q in the SEC submissions (amendments excluded), ordered by reportDate; with at least four, the next report has the form of the 4th latest and the period end of the 4th latest's reportDate + 1 calendar year (the issuer's own cadence, 52/53-week years included); with fewer than four the catalyst is underivable
R3.5_catalyst.deadline: period end + statutory days (Form 10-K General Instruction A, Form 10-Q General Instruction A): 10-K 60 / 75 / 90 days for large accelerated / accelerated / other filers; 10-Q 40 / 40 / 45 days; filer category from submissions.category, unknown -> other; a Saturday/Sunday deadline rolls to Monday
R3.5_catalyst.sources: the latest periodic report's source id when it is in the package, else the latest 10-K source
R3.5_catalyst.basis: D0 §K lists earnings as a catalyst type, horizon 'weeks to 3 months' (§R); materiality and timing confidence are AI-owned (D0 §V) and no frozen rule sets them
R3.5_catalyst.underivable: fewer than four periodic reports, no reportDate, or no citable source: the record is refused (no final_output) instead of written with zero catalysts, because zero would fire D6's no-catalyst REJECT on missing data

R3.6_risks.rule: EVIDENCE_GAP for each of revenue, operating_income, eps_diluted, free_cash_flow, operating_margin whose code-owned state is UNKNOWN (source: the LATEST_10K source); DILUTION when shares_outstanding state is INCREASING (source: that point's filing)
R3.6_risks.basis: RiskCategory EVIDENCE_GAP and DILUTION are the enum members whose meaning equals a code-owned fact; every other category needs a reading of filing text

R3.7_invalidation.basis: no frozen deterministic invalidation condition exists

R3.8_ai_owned_lists.basis: AI-owned interpretation; unread or count-only in D6

R3.9_why_now.rule: summary 'Deterministic re-evaluation on code-owned evidence.', reasons empty

R3.10_unknown_fields.rule: always growth_durability, future_business, catalyst_materiality, invalidation_candidates, competitive_position, management_execution; plus business_model when R3.1 is empty and fundamental_change when R3.2 is empty

R3.11_completeness.rule: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when R3.1 and R3.2 are both empty, else PARTIAL

inputs_code_owned.event price reaction: price_engine: 1d/3d raw and benchmark-adjusted returns per official event, alignment flag (fraction)
inputs_code_owned.guidance / management passages: located by frozen term lists; their reading is AI-owned (D4 §Q)
inputs_code_owned.guidance direction arithmetic: classify_range_movement / result_vs_range exist but need ranges transcribed from text, which is AI-owned (D4 §Q)
inputs_code_owned.fundamental states: D1/E2 via the D2 bundle and R3.2

G1_POSITIVE_WIDE_POSITIVE.rule: inadmissible while the count of code-owned non-price expectation items is 0
G1_POSITIVE_WIDE_POSITIVE.basis: C1 (D4 §L): a POSITIVE needs a guidance assessment, a result-vs-guidance comparison or a sourced management signal; all three need a transcription D4 §Q gives to AI; C2 additionally needs a future-business item above STORY

G2_NEGATIVE_WIDE_NEGATIVE.basis: D0 §L 'deterioration ... that does not yet appear reflected in price/guidance'; D4 §L 'a large completed re-rating is direct evidence that expectations moved': neither the size of a re-rating nor the reaction that counts as 'reflected' is frozen anywhere

G3_NEUTRAL.basis: D0 §L 'market's current pricing is a reasonable reflection': no frozen test; D6-equivalent to UNKNOWN

G4_UNKNOWN.rule: the state whenever G1-G3 do not apply; C6 recorded when the bundle has no price reaction
G4_UNKNOWN.basis: D0 §L UNKNOWN 'a pricing-in assessment cannot be made responsibly'; D4 §P 'producing many UNKNOWNs is the engine working'

rules.confidence: C5: UNKNOWN with UNKNOWN; ceiling from C4 (gap_contract.confidence_ceiling); C3 input not evaluated (conflicts are model-declared)

expected_effect_on_d6_declared_before_ru.APPROVE: unreachable: G1 (C1) and R3.4/R3.5 materiality/R3.7 each block it
expected_effect_on_d6_declared_before_ru.REJECT: reachable through D5 fully priced, through R3.1/R3.2 empty, or through a next report whose deadline is beyond the horizon; never through the gap
expected_effect_on_d6_declared_before_ru.NOT_DECISION_ELIGIBLE: only when R3.12 validation fails or R3.5 is underivable, or D5 abstains

difference_classes.C: historical model violated or overstated the contract
difference_classes.D: deterministic implementation bug (the only class that allows a code fix)

verdict_rule: class E on a D6-binding path is NEEDS REVISION for this stage, recorded, never patched inside this version
